t.etext: Most exports are seafood such as shrimp and halibut, and a grant from the Danish government is a large part of its budget. Melting ice has drawn attention to minerals such as rare earths and uranium and to Arctic shipping routes, and repeated US statements that it wants to buy the island have made it an international issue.
